framing.lineOfInquiry: Aarti Kumar (P00047) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE039
framing.alternate: Aarti Kumar (P00047) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was elsewhere at the time (alibi)
alternateHypotheses.statement: Aarti Kumar was somewhere else when the incident happened.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Recorded at an unnamed place, 16.6 km from the scene, 56 min after the incident — the scene was reachable by road in that time, so this is only a partial alibi
Recorded at an unnamed place, 16.6 km from the scene, 178 min after the incident — the scene was reachable by road in that time, so this is only a partial alibi

alternateHypotheses.test: Verify the alibi record independently (CCTV, witnesses or receipts at that place and time) and check whether the device could have been carried by someone else.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Aarti Kumar was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as witness, not as accused

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason
alternateHypotheses.statement: Aarti Kumar was near the scene because they regularly go there (home, work, market), not because of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded within 1 km of the scene on 28 other days (09 May – 30 Jun), so presence there is part of their routine

alternateHypotheses.test: Establish why the person is regularly there (address, employment, shop) and compare the incident-time visit with their usual pattern (time of day, duration).

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Aarti Kumar's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak
